literal: Duty having known, time having considered, place having known, having deliberated, he who speaks is chief.
translation: The best envoy is one who knows his duty, considers the right time, knows the right place, and speaks after careful deliberation.
modern: தன் கடமையை அறிந்து, ஏற்ற காலத்தை நினைவில் கொண்டு, தகுந்த இடத்தை அறிந்து, சொல்ல வேண்டியதை ஆராய்ந்து சொல்பவனே சிறந்த தூதன் ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet defines the qualities of the best envoy or ambassador. The word 'தலை' literally means head, but here it takes the accepted sense of chief or the best. To achieve this rank, the envoy must first understand their duty. Then, they must carefully evaluate the time and place before speaking with thorough deliberation.
